- Confirm whether you'll run from a browser or behind a corporate VPN (affects screen-sharing approach)

Ops runbook (attached) includes minimal firewall rules, temporary API key instructions, and a small diagnostic command set — if you can drop that with the sample dataset ahead of the call, we can start the demo at T+0.
